cour_recre.title: The Playground
cour_recre.text:
It's recess.

You are with your best friend Tom.
And three other classmates.

Tom is trying to draw a picture in his notebook.

He isn't very good at drawing.
He knows it.
But he tries anyway.

The others are watching.

You want to make everyone laugh.

So you say something.

**"Haha, it looks like a blob with legs."**

The others laugh.

Tom doesn't laugh.

He closes his notebook.

choices.text: Keep laughing along with the others.

regard_tom.title: Tom's Look
regard_tom.text:
Tom looks at you.

Just for a second.

Not angry.

Something worse.

Disappointed.

He puts his notebook in his bag.
He gets up.
He goes to sit somewhere else.

All by himself.

The others have already forgotten.

Aikito was lying under the bench.
He lifts his head toward you.

**"Did you see his face?"**

aikito_mots.title: What Aikito Knows
aikito_mots.text:
Aikito sits down in front of you.

**"Words make no sound when you say them."**
**"But they make a lot of noise in the head of the one who hears them."**

You look at Tom from a distance.

He is drawing again.
All alone.
Head down.

**"He's still drawing?"** you ask.

**"Yes."** says Aikito.
**"But he doesn't draw the way he used to."**

You look more closely.

He has closed his notebook on his knees.
As if to hide it.

choices.text: Go and talk to him now.

aller_parler.title: Going Over to Tom
aller_parler.text:
You walk over to Tom.

It's hard.

Your feet are moving slower than usual.

Tom watches you coming.
He holds his notebook tight.

You sit down next to him.

Silence.

Aikito watches you both from a distance.
He says nothing.

It's up to you.

choices.text: Say nothing and stay right there.

fin_recre.title: The Bell
fin_recre.text:
The bell rings.

Everyone goes back to class.

Tom walks past you without looking at you.

Aikito walks beside you.

**"You wanted to wait for the right moment."**
**"But the right moment was before."**

In class, Tom sits far away from you.

Normally, you sit side by side.

choices.text: Wait until the end of school.

mot_papier.title: The Note
mot_papier.text:
You tear off a little piece of paper.

You think for a long time.

What do you write in situations like this?

You just write:

*Sorry. That wasn't nice.*

You fold it.
You pass it to Tom.

He reads it.
He reads it again.

He says nothing.

But he looks at you.
Not the way he did before.
Not yet.

Just... he looks at you.

vraie_excuse.title: The Real Apology
vraie_excuse.text:
Tom looks at you.

**"So why did you say it?"**

You think about it.

Really think.

**"To make the others laugh."**
**"It was stupid."**

Tom stays silent.

**"My drawing was bad anyway."** he says.

**"No."**

Tom looks up.

**"You were trying."** you go on.
**"That's different."**

Aikito wags his tail behind you.

fausse_excuse.title: Not Quite
fausse_excuse.text:
Tom shrugs.

**"A little."**

Silence.

**"It was just to joke around."** you say.

Tom looks away.

**"I know."**

Aikito comes over to you very gently.

He whispers, just for you.

**"You said sorry."**
**"But you didn't tell him you were wrong."**
**"That's not the same."**

silence_repare.title: Right Here
silence_repare.text:
You stay sitting next to him.

Without saying anything.

Tom draws.

After a while,
he turns the notebook toward you.

It's a dog.

Not perfect.
But you can tell it's a dog.

**"Is that Aikito?"** you ask.

**"I was trying."** says Tom.

Aikito comes over.
He looks at the drawing.
He wags his tail.

dessin_ensemble.title: A New Drawing
dessin_ensemble.text:
Tom opens his notebook.

He shows you the page.

It's full of drawings.

Houses.
Animals.
People with round heads.

**"I'm trying to learn."** he says.
**"It's hard."**

**"You can keep learning."** you say.
**"Even if it's not perfect."**

Tom thinks about it.

**"Why don't you draw with me?"**
**"You're even worse than I am."**

He smiles.

Really this time.

apres_cours.title: After School
apres_cours.text:
At the end of the day, Tom is waiting for you.

A little apart.

He hands you the piece of paper back.

**"You could have just said it."**

**"I know."** you answer.
**"I didn't dare."**

Tom looks at his shoes.

**"Was my drawing really a blob with legs?"**

You hesitate.

**"A little."**

He laughs.

Not for very long.
But for real.

trop_tard.title: The End of the Day
trop_tard.text:
At the school exit, Tom has already left.

You look for him.

Aikito is beside you.

**"He went straight home."**

You stay on the sidewalk.

**"I'll talk to him tomorrow."** you think.

Aikito looks at you.

**"The words we say stay for a long time."**
**"So do apologies."**
**"But they fix things less well the next day."**

fin_repare.title: Ending — Words That Mend
fin_repare.text:
You both draw together.

It really isn't pretty.

Aikito rests his head on the notebook.

Tom draws Aikito with a halo.

You draw Tom holding a giant pencil.

You both laugh.

For real.

Aikito looks up at you.

**"Words can hurt."**
**"But good words can also mend things."**
**"You just have to find the right ones."**

Tom closes the notebook.

**"Do we keep going tomorrow?"**

**"Yeah."**

fin_lente.title: Ending — Almost Like Before
fin_lente.text:
You walk home together.

You don't talk much.

But you walk side by side.

Aikito trots between you.

**"Is it fixed?"** you whisper to Aikito.

**"Almost."** he says.
**"Words leave marks."**
**"But the marks fade with time."**

**"Time... it takes a long while."**

**"Yes."** says Aikito.
**"That's why it's better to think before you speak."**

fin_demain.title: Ending — The Evening Message
fin_demain.text:
In the evening, you send him a message.

*Sorry about this morning. That was awful.*

You wait.

A long time.

Then three little dots appear.

*Ok.*

Just *Ok.*

Aikito is lying down next to you.

**"It's good that you did it."**

**"But he only answered 'Ok'..."**

**"Yes."** says Aikito.
**"Apologies sent in the evening fix things less well."**
**"Tomorrow, talk to him for real."**
